**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bundler now sends `retryCount`. It takes either shape. See [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. Unset now means off, the old default. See [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are still printed. They are hardcoded in `build.js` and name files that do not exist here.

Next: nothing, unless you want those warning lines cut from `build.js`.
